purpose: Audit of whether comparative texts are actually stored as searchable local raw text, represented by source metadata/book indexes, fetched on demand, or merely planned. Structural reader depth is tracked separately from local full-text custody.
rule: A text is locally-full-text-ready only when the repository contains the reusable source wording itself in stable local files. A functioning reader, source manifest, remote fetch path or book index does not by itself count as local full-text custody.

coverage.label: Poetic Edda
coverage.notes: Complete Bellows edition stored locally as raw UTF-8 text; reader searches the complete edition and exposes the poem structure.

coverage.label: Prose Edda / Younger Edda
coverage.notes: Complete Anderson edition stored locally as raw UTF-8 text; reader searches the complete edition and exposes its major sections.

coverage.label: Christian Bible / active WEB reader
coverage.source_mode: World English Bible source metadata and deterministic 66-book index are local; complete WEB wording is still treated as upstream/on-demand until book files are vendored.
coverage.notes: The Bible comparator/corpus architecture is active and validated. Do not confuse the mature relation/scene/comparator layer with local custody of the complete primary text.
coverage.next_action: Vendor the complete public-domain WEB book files locally, preserve chapter/verse/source metadata, then switch this status to verified-local-full-text only after corpus tests use the local files.

coverage.label: Torah / Tanakh
coverage.next_action: Add a legally reusable local full-text edition where permitted, then register book/chapter/verse structure and provenance.

coverage.label: Dao De Jing
coverage.next_action: Add a legally reusable local edition where permitted, preserving chapter boundaries and translation metadata.

coverage.label: Comparative Wisdom Library
coverage.next_action: Build each work as a distinct corpus record. Do not populate the library with summaries alone.

next_targets: Tanakh / Torah local full-text edition where legally reusable
